newsitems.title: Marvel Rivals Version 20261001 Patch Notes
newsitems.author: Marvel Rivals
newsitems.contents:
[p]Greetings, Rivals![/p][p align="justify"]We're thrilled to announce the upcoming patch drops on October 1st, 2026, at 09 : 00 : 00 (UTC)! No server downtime; just patch and play![/p][p align="justify"]Here's what's coming your way:[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h2][b]All-New Content[/b][/h2][h3][b]New In Store[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]- Luna Snow - Lunar Luna
- Phoenix - Cosmic Spark
- Luna Snow - Lunar Luna Chroma Pink Planets/Dark Nebula and Ultimate Ability VFX[/p][p align="justify"]Availability: [b][u]October 2nd, 2026, 02 : 00 : 00 to October 30th 2026, 02 : 00 : 00 (UTC)[/u][/b][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]Pop & Win[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]Pop & Win brings fresh rewards! This week welcomes Luna Snow's Lunar Luna and Phoenix's Cosmic Spark. Step right up and test your luck for a chance to snag these two absolute stars for an out-of-this-world discount! Don't let this cosmic opportunity burn out before you shoot your shot![/p][p align="justify"]Event Duration: [b][u]September 17th, 2026, 09 : 00 : 00 to October 16th, 2026, 02 : 00 : 00 (UTC)[/u][/b][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]Esports[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]Predictions for the Marvel Rivals Ignite Series Stage 2 Playoffs will officially open on October 5. Please take note of the prediction deadlines for the Playoffs:[/p][p align="justify"]Pacific Series Deadline: [b][u]October 8, 05 : 50 (UTC)[/u][/b]
Americas Series Deadline: [b][u]October 15, 19 : 50 (UTC)[/u][/b]
EMEA Series Deadline: [b][u]October 15, 10 : 50 (UTC)[/u][/b]
China Series Deadline: [b][u]October 16, 06 : 50 (UTC)[/u][/b][/p][p align="justify"]By participating in Playoff predictions and watching the matches through the in-game broadcast, you can complete event quests to earn rewards such as Nameplates, Titles, Units, and more![/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h2][b]Fixes and Optimizations[/b][/h2][h3][b]Other[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]- Rogue's Restricted Airspace: Fixed a typo in the ability description for Rogue's stolen Adam Warlock ability that wildly claimed she could enter "fly freely." The X-Men's southern belle is staying grounded this time!    
- Pajama Party Preferences: Fixed an issue in the Jeff's Superstar Search event where clicking the "GO" button to matchmake forced the lobby to switch to Quick Match. Everyone can now battle for those stars in any mode they see fit.    
- Chroma Custodian Clean-up: Fixed a UI glitch in the Customize menu where the description text for a Chroma would get stuck on the screen after unselecting it. The costume interface is now sparkling clean.    [/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]The Marvel Rivals universe is ever-evolving, and we have plenty more surprises and updates in store. Stay tuned to our official announcements for more![/p]

newsitems.title: Marvel Rivals Version 20260924 Patch Notes
newsitems.author: Marvel Rivals
newsitems.contents:
[p]Greetings, Rivals![/p][p align="justify"]We're thrilled to announce the upcoming patch drops on September 24th, 2026, at 09 : 00 : 00 (UTC)! No server downtime; just patch and play![/p][p align="justify"]Here's what's coming your way:[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h2][b]All-New Content[/b][/h2][h3][b]New In Store[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]- Mantis - Morning Dew Bundle
- Daredevil - Dare-Dragon Bundle[/p][p align="justify"]Limited Time: [b][u]September 25th, 2026, 02 : 00 : 00 to October 23rd, 2026, 02 : 00 : 00 (UTC)[/u][/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Thor - King Thor Bundle
- Morning Dew - Emoji Bundle
- Mantis - Morning Dew Chroma Dreamy Dew/Sunny Snooze and Ultimate Ability VFX
- Jeff the Land Shark - Breakfin'[/p][p align="justify"]Available From: [b][u]September 25th, 2026, at 2 : 00 : 00 (UTC)[/u][/b][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]LAST SPLASH: SWIMSUIT SPECIAL COSTUMES LEAVING SOON[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]Sun, surf, and saving the Chronoverse! The summer memories we've forged alongside our favorite heroes have been nothing short of marvelous. Thank you, Rivals, for your incredible love and support for the Swimsuit Special series! As the seasons shift and this beach party winds down, these exclusive summer looks will be leaving the store in two waves:[/p][p align="justify"][b]Wave 1 Departures:[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Emma Frost - White Wave Queen, Doctor Strange - Nautical Mystic, Daredevil - Sonar Savior, Black Widow - Aquatic Assassin, Captain America - Seaside Sentinel, Lady Loki - Seaside Siren, and White Fox - Coastal Kumiho.[/p][p align="justify"]These costumes will no longer be available for purchase after [b][u]October 16th, 2026, 02 : 00 : 00 (UTC).[/u][/b][/p][p align="justify"][b]Wave 2 Departures:[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Magik - Soul Surfer, Scarlet Witch - Seaside Sorceress, and Storm - Sacred Skies.[/p][p align="justify"]These costumes will no longer be available for purchase after [b][u]November 20th, 2026, 02 : 00 : 00 (UTC).[/u][/b][/p][p align="justify"]Additionally, [b]Krakoan Reels Vol.2 [/b]will officially conclude on [b][u]October 15th, 2026, 09 : 00 : 00 (UTC).[/u][/b][/p][p align="justify"]Every party has to end eventually. Don't miss your chance to secure your favorite swimsuit styles before they dive back into the vault! Let the heat of summer ride with you into your next epic battle![/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]New Map: God Quarry[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]The God Butcher twisted the hallowed parliament of pantheons, Omnipotence City, into a roving citadel of despair, ultimately crashing it into the very Cradle of Creation. This legendary nexus, existing in a dimension beyond space and time to chronicle the triumphs of heroes, now teeters on the precipice of the Abyss. Soon, the sacred halls where deities once whispered their dying confessions will become the epicenter of their absolute annihilation. As the Godbomb edges closer to completion, Gorr's vision of an era belonging strictly to mortals seems just one step away. But the God Butcher never expected his final obstacle to be the very mortals he claims to be fighting for.[/p][p align="justify"]The God Quarry arrives as a Domination map. After the update, a limited-time Quick Match mode solely for this new map will also be available.[/p][p align="justify"]Limited-Time Quick Match Period: [b][u]September 24th, 2026, 09 : 00 : 00 to September 29th, 2026, 08 : 59 : 00 (UTC)[/u][/b][/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://r.res.easebar.com/pic/20260923/a02e6206-2674-423c-b7d6-c9b8897d5493.jpg" style="border: 0px; image-rendering: crisp-edges; max-width: 9rem; display: block; margin: 0px auto;"][/img][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]Galacta's Gift Vol.3[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]The long-awaited Costume Coin is finally making a glorious return! The Exchange Store is also receiving a massive update, adding a large batch of costumes for a limited time.[/p][p align="justify"]Event Period: September 24th, 2026, 09 : 00 : 00 to November 13th, 2026, 09 : 00 : 00 (UTC)[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h2][b]Fixes and Optimizations[/b][/h2][h3][b]Other[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]Devil Dinosaur's KO Cutoff: Fixed an issue where the Lord icon was misaligned in the KO feed. Moon Girl has straightened out her prehistoric pal's UI, dino dominance is back on track!   [/p][p align="justify"]
The Marvel Rivals universe is ever-evolving; we have plenty more surprises and changes in store. Stay tuned to our official announcements for more![/p]

newsitems.title: Marvel Rivals Version 20260917 Patch Notes
newsitems.author: Marvel Rivals
newsitems.contents:
[p]Greetings, Rivals![/p][p align="justify"]We're thrilled to announce the upcoming patch drops on [b][u]September 17th, 2026, at 09 : 00 : 00 (UTC)[/u][/b]! No server downtime; just patch and play![/p][p align="justify"]Here's what's coming your way:[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h2][b]All-New Content[/b][/h2][h3][b]New Stories[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]- New Moon Knight Lore - New Moon Rising[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]New In Store[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]- Moon Knight - Eternity Knight Bundle
- New Jeff the Land Shark - Jeff-Pool costume chroma: Gwenpool
- Rogue & Gambit - X-Men '97 Season 2 MVP: Sugah, the MVPs are now officially live and have been added to their respective bundles, with bundle prices remaining unchanged. Eligible players who previously owned everything in the corresponding bundles will automatically receive the matching MVPs for free.[/p][p align="justify"]Available From: [b][u]September 17th, 2026, at 9 : 00 : 00 (UTC)[/u][/b][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]Pop & Win[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]Pop & Win keeps bringing the absolute goodies! This week, we're spotlighting Jubilee's Vampy Jammies and Magneto's Master of Slumber. Step right up and test your luck for a chance to snag these two nap-tacular Pajama Party costumes for a wildly discounted price![/p][p align="justify"]Event Duration: [b][u]September 17th, 2026, 09 : 00 : 00 to October 16th, 2026, 02 : 00 : 00 (UTC)[/u][/b][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]All-New Events[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]Rogue recently threw a totally radical pajama party! However, after the party wound down, Jeff fell into a terrifying nightmare. Guided by Mantis's telepathic expertise, the crew dove straight into Jeff's dream, only to discover a giant star suspended in the sky, surrounded by a chaotic flurry of bizarre thoughts.
The heroes on the scene quickly split into two teams to investigate this psychic phenomenon.[/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://r.res.easebar.com/pic/20260916/cef7fc72-a556-4ada-95e7-92e4694d98d4.png" style="border: 0px; image-rendering: crisp-edges; max-width: 9rem; display: block; margin: 0px auto;"][/img][/p][p align="justify"][b]Jeff's Dream Eater[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Relying on his unique radar sense, Daredevil stayed behind in Jeff's dream, carefully collecting our favorite shark's scattered, whimsical thoughts. He's attempting to track down the source of the nightmare hiding deep within Jeff's subconscious.
Complete the event to acquire Venom's President Ozzy costume and related bundle content for FREE! Unlock premium for Rogue's Slumber Sugah, Jeff the Land Shark's Shark in Sheep's Clothing, and more.[/p][p align="justify"]Event Period: [b][u]September 17th, 2026, 09 : 00 : 00 to October 15th, 2026, 09 : 00 : 00 (UTC)[/u][/b][/p][p align="justify"][b]Jeff's Superstar Search[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Meanwhile, the rest of the heroes followed the trail of the dream-star! Heading out to Times Square and Hellfire Bay Beach in search of the Superstar from Jeff's dream.
Collect Stars to earn rewards including a Spray, Title, and Nameplate.[/p][p align="justify"]Event Period: [b][u]September 17th, 2026, 09 : 00 : 00 to October 9th, 2026, 09 : 00 : 00 (UTC)[/u][/b][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]New Content[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]Feeling generous? PYO Bundles now support Gifting! Gifts are purchased using Lattice, and the price will automatically adjust based on both the cosmetics you select and which items your fellow rival already owns.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]Balance Adjustments[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]Significantly reduced the probability of the Scarlet Witch being immune to incoming damage during Reality Erasure (Ultimate Ability) wind up.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h2][b]Fixes and Optimizations[/b][/h2][h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]- Deadpool's Clone Conundrum: Fixed an issue in Clone Rumble where players were unable to switch Team-Ups when randomized as Deadpool. Wade got a little too attached, but we've untangled the Merc with a Mouth so he can swap his besties at will!  [/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]Other[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]- Jeff's Ducky Dip Details: Fixed a missing texture issue with Jeff the Land Shark's Ducky Dip emote. Our favorite land shark's bath time is back to being picture-perfect. Splish splash, Jeff!   
- Peni Parker's Portrait Polish: Fixed a visual inconsistency between the physical eye models and the 2D portrait artwork for Peni Parker's Liquid Shell costume. The SP//dr suit's optic sensors are fully synced, and Peni's looking sharply aligned in every dimension!    
- Doctor Strange's Astral Smile: Fixed a teeth texture display issue on Doctor Strange's Astral Arcana costume. The Sorcerer Supreme shouldn't have to battle multiversal dental issues; his mystic grin is now totally flawless. By the Hoary Hosts of Hoggoth!  
- Emma Frost's Telepathic Tunes: Fixed an issue where the sound effects for Emma's Psychic Spear ability would sometimes play incorrectly while she was wearing her Glittering Goddess costume. The White Queen demands absolute perfection, and her psychic broadcasts are now perfectly clear.  [/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]The Marvel Rivals universe is ever-evolving, and we have plenty more surprises and updates in store. Stay tuned to our official announcements for more![/p]

newsitems.title: Marvel Rivals Version 20260911 Patch Notes - Season 10 Arrives
newsitems.author: Marvel Rivals
newsitems.contents:
[p]Greetings, Rivals![/p][p align="justify"]After assassinating two deities back-to-back, the mysterious God Butcher has finally revealed his true face.[/p][p align="justify"]This update begins on [b][u]September 11th, 2026, at 09 : 00 : 00 (UTC)[/u][/b], with estimated maintenance lasting 2 hours.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h2][b]All-New Content[/b][/h2][h3][b]New Villain[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]Gorr the God Butcher brings his unholy crusade to Marvel Rivals![/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]New Stories[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]- New Serial - Butcher's Blasphemy
- New Gorr the God Butcher Lore - All Gods Will Die
- New Loki Lore - Journey into Mystery[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]Scarlet Witch Rework[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]Wanda is weaving a new brand of chaos! We have completed a rework of Scarlet Witch's abilities and gameplay to better channel her hex-casting might. To see exactly how Wanda is altering reality this patch, please check out the full breakdown on our official website.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]New In Store[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]- Cloak & Dagger - Dreamy Duo Bundle[/p][p align="justify"]Availability: [b][u]September 11th, 2026, 09 : 00 : 00 to October 9th 2026, 09 : 00 : 00 (UTC)[/u][/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Gorr the God Butcher - Divine Destroyer Bundle
- Emma Frost - Glittering Goddess Bundle
- Gorr the God Butcher - Blue Requiem
- Cloak & Dagger - Dreamy Duo Chroma Pastel Peace/Dreamy Daze and Ultimate Ability VFX
- Emma Frost - Glittering Goddess Chroma Golden Grace/Dark Diamond and Ultimate Ability VFX
- Divine Destroyer - Emoji Bundle
- Dreamy Duo - Emoji Bundle
- Glittering Goddess - Emoji Bundle
- Take a Seat: New animations for The Hood and Gorr the God Butcher.[/p][p align="justify"]Available From: [b][u]September 11th, 2026, at 9 : 00 : 00 (UTC)[/u][/b][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]Season 4 Battle Pass Return[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]The Season 4 Battle Pass, Fruit of Immortality, will return for a limited time! It can be purchased via the Reality Link Point interface in the Battle Pass menu.[/p][p align="justify"]Limited-Time Rerun: [b][u]September 11th, 2026, 09 : 00 : 00 to September 24th, 2026, 09 : 00 : 00 (UTC)[/u][/b][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]Endgame Encore - Event Extension[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]To continue celebrating the re-release of Avengers: Endgame, we are extending the Endgame Encore event!
During the event, you can continue to enjoy a 20% discount using the Encore Coupon to purchase MCU-themed Costume Bundles.[/p][p align="justify"]Extended Period: [b][u]September 11th, 2026, 09 : 00 : 00 to October 9th, 2026, 09 : 00 : 00 (UTC)[/u][/b][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]S10 Battle Pass[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]Unlock an explosive new Battle Pass, The Godbomb, featuring 10 all-new sets of heroic costumes! Highlights include: White Fox - Cosmic Kumiho, Captain America - Astral Aegis, and Loki - The Chronicler.[/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://r.res.easebar.com/pic/20260909/2fbeb47f-f172-4703-a5c3-da81f7edc13d.png" style="border: 0px; image-rendering: crisp-edges; max-width: 9rem; display: block; margin: 0px auto;"][/img][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]Season Event: The Tetrameron[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]The brand-new seasonal story event, The Tetrameron, is about to begin. Assist Loki, The Chronicler, in completing tasks to earn abundant rewards![/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://r.res.easebar.com/pic/20260909/6ac64a33-ada3-4e0f-80a9-ef540ab7a918.png" style="border: 0px; image-rendering: crisp-edges; max-width: 9rem; display: block; margin: 0px auto;"][/img][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]Achievement System Refinements[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]Due to recent story and map updates, the conditions to complete certain achievements are no longer valid. We have updated these achievements accordingly. Your previous progress will automatically carry over, and previously completed achievements will not be affected; you do not need to reunlock them.[/p][p align="justify"]Affected Achievements:
- Completion conditions for the achievement "What a Team-Up!" have been updated.
- Completion conditions for the achievement "Cute, Smart, Clever" have been updated.
- "Echoes of the Abyss" has been changed to "Missing Sword Notice".
- "Darkness and Light" has been changed to "White Hot History".
- "Kings in Black" has been changed to "Egg-sitting".
- "Whispers of Oblivion" has been changed to "The Sword is Drawn".
- "Can't Make An Omelette…" has been changed to "Living Landscape".[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]Twitch Drops[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]As Season 10 kicks off, get ready for a new round of Twitch Drops.
This round's drops include the Squirrel Girl - Will of Galacta costume along with related bundle content.[/p][p align="justify"]Drops Period: [b][u]September 11th, 2026, at 12 : 00 : 00 (UTC) to October 9th, 2026, at 09 : 00 : 00 (UTC) [/u][/b][/p][p align="justify"]Starting September 17, we will gradually roll out drops for the Marvel Rivals IGNITE Series Stage 2 Regular Season and Playoffs.
The Watcher isn't the only one keeping an eye on the action; Galacta herself is distributing cosmic bounties! Rack up enough watch time to appease our favorite cosmic entity and claim the Cyclops - Will of Galacta costume along with related bundle content, alongside a series of esports-themed drops.[/p][p align="justify"]Drops Period: Released in batches starting from the Group Stage at [b][u]09 : 00 : 00, September 17th (UTC)[/u][/b]. The final batch goes live for the Playoffs on [b][u]October 15th at 11 : 00 (UTC)[/u][/b]. Please note that some drops can only be earned by watching matches during their specific week.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]Rank Rewards[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]Season 10.0 Gold-tier costume reward is Gorr the God Butcher - Gods' Graveyard.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]College Perks[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]College Perk costumes are changing to the following:
Iron Man - Extrembiote Armor, Hela - The Grim Lady, Angela - Skuld 2099, Emma Frost - Queen of Diamonds, Deadpool - Captain Pool, Magneto - Seat of Autumn, Psylocke - Once-Captive Corsair, Elsa Bloodstone - Young Blood, Human Torch - Jack of Hearts, Angela - Ace of Spades[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h2][b]Esports[/b][/h2][h3][b]Marvel Rivals IGNITE Stage 2[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]Stage 2 of the Marvel Rivals IGNITE Series is about to fully launch![/p][p align="justify"]Regular Season: Kicks off on September 17th with the Oceania Series and China Series. On September 18th, the Americas and EMEA Series begin simultaneously. The Asia Series will join the regular season schedule on September 25th.[/p][p align="justify"]Playoffs: On October 8th, the Pacific Series (the merged Asia and Oceania Series) will open the playoffs, fighting for 2 seats at the 2026 IGNITE Grand Finals. On October 15th, the Americas and EMEA Series will begin their respective playoffs, each battling for 4 Grand Final seats. The China Series will take the spotlight on October 16th, concluding the playoffs and deciding the final 2 seats for the Grand Finals.[/p][p align="justify"]Ultimately, 12 teams will assemble on the Grand Finals stage for the ultimate showdown.[/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://r.res.easebar.com/pic/20260909/f8a0ee56-142f-48d7-8d47-94da82bcc8d5.png" style="border: 0px; image-rendering: crisp-edges; max-width: 9rem; display: block; margin: 0px auto;"][/img][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]Marvel Rivals Championship[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]Marvel Rivals Championship Season 10 is charging into action! Whether you're a team of seasoned Avengers or rising street-level defenders, simply participate in the Open Qualifiers and complete at least 6 matches to secure your roster a hefty sum of Units and a vault full of exclusive loot (check the in-game MRC rewards preview for the full details).[/p][p align="justify"]If your Faction has what it takes at the top level, pay close attention: Season 10 MRC will continue to accumulate Champion Points for your Faction toward the 2026 Season. Following this season, only Season 11 remains as the final stop for 2026 Championship Points. After the 2026 competitive year, the top-performing Factions from the Season 11 MRC and those ranking high on the 2026 Champion Points leaderboard will be invited to compete in the Ignite Series 2026 Annual Qualifier, where they'll battle alongside select pro-circuit teams for a starting spot in the 2027 Pro Circuit! For the exact rules of engagement, consult the in-game MRC page or our official social channels.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]Esports System[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]Following this maintenance, all details regarding the Marvel Rivals IGNITE Series Stage 2, including format, match schedules, participating teams, and player info, will be updated in the in-game Esports system. Players can also subscribe to specific tournament phases within the system. Once subscribed, you will receive in-game notifications before those matches begin (subscriptions can be canceled at any time).[/p][p align="justify"]Group Stage Predictions for Phase 2 are officially open! Participate in group stage predictions before September 17th, subscribe to schedules/teams/players, and watch matches through the in-game Livestreams tab to complete event missions and earn rewards like Sprays, Titles, Units, and more.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]Intel® XeSS 3 Frame Generation[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]We have added support for Intel® XeSS 3 Frame Generation. When enabled on compatible Intel graphics cards, it can insert up to three AI-generated frames between two rendered frames to boost visual smoothness. Combined with Intel® Xe Low Latency (XeLL) technology to reduce input lag, this provides players with a much smoother and more responsive gaming experience.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h2][b]Fixes and Optimizations[/b][/h2][h3][b]Heroes[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]- Cloak & Dagger's Laggy Veil: Fixed an issue where casting abilities might suffer a delayed response after switching forms while using the Oblivion Shroud Team-Up. The duo of light and dark is back in perfect sync, no more hesitation when stepping out of the shadows!  
- Devil Dinosaur's Accidental Escort: Addressed a quirky bug where Devil Dinosaur using Savage Predation to bite an enemy had a chance to glitch the poor opponent into the allied spawn room. Moon Girl gave him a stern talking-to; enemies are officially off the VIP guest list!    
- Rocket's Krakoan Misstep: Fixed an issue where Rocket Raccoon could experience abnormal positioning errors after passing through Krakoan gates while using the Planet X Pals Team-Up. Even a genius trash panda needs his portals calibrated properly. Safe travels, Rocket!   
- Winter Soldier's Wasted Wipeout: Resolved a bug where Winter Soldier's Ultimate ability would unexpectedly reset when hitting a feigning-death Thor (during the Ragnarok Rebirth Team-Up). Bucky's bionic arm is back to respecting the God of Thunder's theatrical naps.  
- Black Cat's Phantom Footsteps: Optimized Black Cat's footstep audio so her approach can be perceived normally. She's still a master thief, but now you might actually hear the purr-fect heist coming!  
- Emma Frost's Phantom Soundscape: Fixed an issue where the sound effect for the Spirit Breaker Team-Up could trigger even when the Enhanced Effect was inactive. The White Queen's telepathy was manifesting a bit too loudly.  
- Devil Dinosaur's Visual Clutter: Optimized several ability visual effects for Devil Dino (Impact Beam, Buddy Barrier, and the Surf & Turf Team-Up), reducing screen clutter. We cleared the air so you can actually see the giant red Rex stomping toward you!
- Speedy Emote Exploit: Fixed an issue where traversal Emotes for Ultron, Jeff the Land Shark, and Devil Dinosaur could cause their in-game movement speed to glitch during combat. Showing off your moves should be fun, not a tactical speed hack!
- Peni Parker's Speedy Snares: Fixed an issue where Peni's Cyber-Web Snare would unexpectedly enter cooldown immediately upon casting, resulting in a shorter actual cooldown than intended. SP//dr's internal clock has been recalibrated; even a genius pilot can't hack her way out of a proper cooldown![/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]Maps[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]- Optimized certain collisions on the K'un-Lun: Heart of Heaven map to better match the actual models.  [/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]The Marvel Rivals universe is ever-evolving; we have plenty more surprises and changes in store for Season 10. Stay tuned to our official announcements for more![/p]

newsitems.title: Season 10: Butcher's Blasphemy // Dev Vision Vol. 21 | Marvel Rivals
newsitems.author: Marvel Rivals
newsitems.contents: [p]Guangguang and Zhiyong are back again and ready to dive into Dev Vision Vol. 21! 📺[/p][p][/p][p]Tune in now to discover what lies ahead for Season 10, including a new map, exciting events, and a brand-new costume series! [/p][p][/p][p]Fret not, Rivals! Zhiyong tackles all you need to know about the upcoming balance changes and plans for Season 10 as well! [/p][p][/p][p]Uncover how the God Butcher switches things up in Season 10 of Marvel Rivals, arriving on September 11 (UTC)! 💥[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="XfuHC-3hbyk;full"][/previewyoutube]
